name: Fighting Style
description: You adopt a particular style of fighting. Choose one Fighting Style feat (e.g. Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Two-Weapon Fighting). You can replace your style whenever you gain a Fighter level.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Your training allows you to use the mastery property of 3 weapons you are proficient with. You can change which weapons you use this with after a Long Rest. See Weapon Mastery cards for property details.

name: Tactical Mind
description: When you fail an ability check, expend one Second Wind use to add 1d10 to the check instead of healing. If the check still fails, the use is not expended.

name: Improved Critical
description: Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on a d20 roll of 19 or 20.

name: Remarkable Athlete
description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. Immediately after scoring a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
